name: THE BAR
note:
A section of the bar, its stools and the man at it -- one object, drawn together.
FITTED, AND MEASURED BEFORE WIRING: the whole bar came back at x1126-1916 y356-849 against the x1126-1916 y355-849 it replaces -- 1.00x, every edge to the pixel. The previous attempt was 1.55x and 432 pixels too far into the room, and was shipped because the comparison was never run. Giving the generator the footprint as a red box on the original was what fixed it: a box to fit rather than a description to interpret.
Three sections because the bar runs 490 pixels in depth and one anchor cannot put Thad in front of the near end and behind the far one. Cut at x1290 and x1500, where the sprite is bar only; recomposed against the whole, maximum channel difference ZERO. The middle: the man with a boot on the foot rail.

sprite.note:
A SIX-FRAME NOD, derived from the one drawing, applied ONLY above the furniture line. Every other route was measured and rejected: a second whole-group drawing differs by 44.2 mean, an empty-furniture pass redraws the furniture and does not align with a men-only pass, and a companion patch of one man redraws the chair inside its rectangle and blends into a two-armed chimera.
The first derived attempt failed because its region ran to y150, straight through a tabletop whose top edge is at y100, so the table rose with the men. Heads and shoulders sit above that line against transparency, where a man can move freely. Four pixels of nod with a pixel of sway, each man starting two steps into the cycle from his neighbour. The furniture is byte-identical in every frame -- maximum change ZERO, not small.
